## What this session is

You are being asked to try [number] short tasks on [a website / an app /
a prototype]. We are evaluating **the design, not you** — there are no right
or wrong answers, and you can't fail.

## What the software does

The tasks run inside **Scrutinizer**, a research tool that changes how the
screen looks: the area around your mouse pointer stays clear, and everything
farther away is degraded in a way that models human peripheral vision. This
lets us observe how a design holds up when only part of it is clearly visible
at a time.

Scrutinizer is **not an eye tracker**. It does not use a camera, and it does
not know where you are looking — only where the pointer is.

## What we will record

- [ ] Handwritten / typed notes by the moderator
- [ ] Screen recording of the task window
- [ ] Audio recording of the conversation
- [ ] Task timing and completion notes
- [ ] [other — specify]

Everything recorded is labeled with your participant ID, not your name.
Nothing is uploaded automatically: Scrutinizer itself stores no session data
and sends nothing off this computer. Any recordings listed above are made
with separate software, kept [where], retained for [duration], and accessible
to [who].

## Risks and comfort

The degraded periphery can feel unusual and, for some people, mildly tiring
on the eyes. You can take a break at any point, ask for the effect to be
softened (Comfort Mode), or stop entirely.

## Voluntary participation

Taking part is voluntary. You may skip any task, decline to answer any
question, or withdraw at any time — without giving a reason and without
losing [compensation, if any]. If you withdraw, you can ask us to discard
what was recorded up to that point.

## Agreement

I have read the above, had the chance to ask questions, and agree to take
part.
